tokendanceRecoveryTopUp: Your TokenDance balance is insufficient. Top up the account used for this connection, then retry. The current key remains valid.
tokendanceRecoveryReauthorize: This TokenDance key is no longer usable. Reauthorize the platform connection, then retry.
tokendanceRecoveryQuota: This key has reached its periodic quota. Wait for the quota to reset, or reauthorize the connection. No automatic retry or payment will be made.
tokendanceRecoveryAdminRequired: Contact your administrator to manage this platform connection.
FORBIDDEN_ACTION: You are not allowed to perform this action
INTERNAL_ERROR: The server ran into an internal error
TUTORIAL_REMOVED: The interactive tutorial has been removed. Saved conversations and sandbox files are unchanged. Use the learning guide instead.
GIT_NOT_INSTALLED: Git is not installed. Install git and retry this action.
DEFAULT_MODEL_NOT_CONFIGURED: No default model is configured. Choose one in Settings → Models, then retry.
GIT_TREE_MERGE_FALLBACK_FAILED: Git {{version}} does not support {{feature}}. An automatic compatibility merge in a temporary directory was attempted but failed: {{detail}}. Check your Git installation and the temporary directory's permissions and available space, or install Git 2.40+ (for example, install it separately and add it to the server's PATH).
GIT_TREE_MERGE_CONFLICTS_UNLISTED: Merge conflicts were detected, but their full scope or resolution cannot be verified automatically. Automatic application was refused. Resolve the conflicts manually.
MERGE_DIRTY_SOURCE: Commit-mode merge needs a clean source worktree. Commit or stash its changes, or switch back to workspace merge, where uncommitted changes are fine.
MERGE_DIRTY_TARGET: Commit-mode merge needs a clean target worktree. Commit or stash its changes, or switch back to workspace merge, where uncommitted changes are fine.
MERGE_DIRTY_TRUNK: Commit-mode merge needs a clean trunk worktree. Commit or stash trunk's changes, or switch back to workspace merge, where uncommitted changes are fine.
TOKEN_EXPIRED: Your session expired. Sign in again.
TOKEN_INVALID: Your sign-in is no longer valid. Sign in again.
SESSION_REVOKED: Your session was revoked. Sign in again.
SESSION_REQUIRED: This action requires signing in directly, not an API token
OAUTH_TOKEN_REQUIRED: This endpoint requires an OAuth access token
ADMIN_REQUIRES_SESSION: Administrator actions require signing in directly, not an API token
LOGIN_THROTTLED: Too many attempts. Try again later.
